# TASK-159 — specification

## Scope

MCP read and write for agents: read the whole existing specification (resource) and the proposals; get the next tasks that are ready (dependencies done); import an existing `.plan/tasks.md` into the board (preview first); and split the project into tasks with `plan_tasks`, which refuses until a baseline exists and then lists what blocks it. Agents still cannot approve, delete or change review status.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] MCP additions stay inside the quality gate (names, "Use …" descriptions, hints, output schemas, size budget, no approve/delete/baseline tools): a resource with the whole specification, `list_proposals`, `get_next_tasks`, `import_plan_tasks` (the existing `.plan/tasks.md` into the board, with a preview) and `plan_tasks`.
- [x] Specification content still changes only through proposals.
